description: Day 15 gave the harm you fear its own line in the eval. Today is about the cases on that line, and whether they can fail at all.
line: A prompt change ("if the remittance contains an open invoice number, match it") scores 240/240 on the golden set and ships; 37 payments are booked to another customer's invoice ("PO 10452" was the payer's own PO), and replayed on that version the set still scores 240/240
title: Day 16 — A Perfect Score for the Broken Version
